author_photo.rights: Dalibor's own public author portrait, used by him on his Versopolis and Booksa author profiles (a self-portrait at Tower Bridge, London). No separate photographer credit is stated on either page. Treat as author's own image.
author_photo.note: Interim author portrait. It is his canonical public author photo across two platforms, so identity is confirmed, but it is a stylised outdoor self-portrait (face angled, partly in shadow) rather than a studio headshot, and only 720x720. Fine to place now; ideally replace when Dalibor sends a higher-resolution / more conventional portrait.

favicon_source.source: Cropped from author/portrait.jpg (original: Versopolis 720x720 author photo, https://www.versopolis.com/author/54/dalibor-plecic).
favicon_source.rights: Same as the portrait — Dalibor's own public author photo. Cropped, not otherwise altered.
favicon_source.note: Square face crop (head-and-shoulders) made from the portrait for the browser-tab icon; Code resizes this into the favicon. Not a CMS field. Because the face sits in the left half of the source photo, the crop is left-anchored, so a little sky remains on the right — negligible at favicon size, but Code may fine-tune the centering if desired.
